respuesta.razonamiento: Merged visual whiteboard boxes b0-b9 with their corresponding spoken mentions: b0 is the S3 drop bucket, b1 is the S3 data lake (raw and refined buckets), b2 is the on-premises database matched to OnPremDC, b3 is SQS, b4 is the initiator Lambda, b5 is the processing Lambda, b6 is DynamoDB storing metadata, b7 is RedShift, b8 is VPN, and b9 is DMS. CDC was dropped as a separate node because it is a feature of DMS. Added ERP System (ThirdParty) and Business Users (UserCompanyAnalyst) from narration as they have explicit spoken flows. Merged drawn and spoken edges into 13 total edges across 3 workflows.
respuesta.nombre: Hybrid Data Ingestion and Analytics Pipeline with DMS and Serverless S3 Processing

nodes.name: Initiator Lambda
nodes.notes: Pulls metadata and writes to data lake

nodes.name: Processing Lambda
nodes.notes: Processes and feeds data to Redshift

edges.respaldo: line b2->b8 / 'That data is actually piped through our VPN'

edges.notes: DMS pulls data out of VPN via CDC
edges.respaldo: line b8->b9 / 'we use DMS and CDC to be able to pull that data out of our VPN'

edges.notes: DMS populates data into Redshift cluster
edges.respaldo: line b9->b7 / 'populate it into our Redshift cluster'

edges.notes: Redshift data made available to data lake
edges.respaldo: line b7->b1 / 'makes it available to not only our data lake'

edges.notes: ERP system drops demand files into S3 drop bucket
edges.respaldo: 'some of that demand from our ERP system that came into our drop bucket, our S3 drop bucket here'

edges.notes: S3 drop bucket event kicks off SQS message
edges.respaldo: line b0->b3 / 'they actually kick off an SQS that handles all of our messaging services'
line b3->b4 / 'SQS will launch what we call our initiator Lambda job'

edges.notes: Initiator Lambda requests metadata from DynamoDB
edges.respaldo: line b4->b6 / 'This Lambda job actually talks to DynamoDB and it pulls the metadata'

edges.notes: Lambda populates raw and refined buckets in data lake
edges.respaldo: line b4->b1 / 'populate our data lake and push that information into the appropriate structures'

edges.notes: S3 event trigger launches next Lambda job
edges.respaldo: line b1->b5 / 'we have a trigger on our S3 bucket that\'s event driven and it will launch our next Lambda job'

edges.notes: Completed processing is fed into Redshift
edges.respaldo: line b5->b7 / 'Once that completes, that is fed into Redshift again'

edges.notes: Business users query Redshift data warehouse
edges.respaldo: 'our business users and all of our leaderships can use many different tools to be able to query and get that data out'
